_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the KWS front end (architecture §7.3/§B3). tools/gen_frontend_config.py compiles it into firmware/components/microfrontend/include/ps_frontend_config.h (with this file's SHA-256); model/frontend/psfe.py reads it at runtime. Every microfrontend parameter is set explicitly — upstream defaults differ (25 ms window, PCAN off).
int16_from_i2s_word: >> 16 (24-bit INMP441 sample bits 23:8; I2S MSB-justified 32-bit slot, DEC-06/DEC-09)
fft: microfrontend built-in KissFFT, FIXED_POINT=16, real FFT (C-02: esp-dsp float FFT not used, to keep bit-exact parity)
_mel_high_rationale: INMP441 passband = 0.423*fs = 6768 Hz (DS Rev 1.1 Table 1); O1 in §2.3b
int8_mapping: q = clamp(((v * 256) + 333) / 666 - 128, -128, 127) on the uint16 microfrontend output (TFLM micro_speech FeatureProvider mapping)
